name: Toyota FT-86 Concept
designer: Toyota ED² (European Design and Development), Nice

power.sourceNote: Toyota published no output for the concept. It was shown with the D-4S boxer engine that reached production, but a concept's figures are frequently claims rather than measurements, and here there is not even a claim.

hero.alt: Red Toyota FT-86 Concept coupé on a motor-show stand, seen from the front three-quarter angle, with a low nose and heavily flared wheel arches
hero.caption: The FT-86 Concept at the 2009 Tokyo Motor Show. The red was mixed specially for the car, and Toyota said it was based on the colouring of a Japanese macaque.
